globalProperty.value: SELECT DISTINCT primaryIdentifier.identifier as identifier, concat(pn.given_name,' ', pn.family_name) as name, p.gender as gender, p.uuid as patient_uuid, p.birthdate as date_of_birth, ma.uuid as medication_administration_uuid, ma.administered_date_time, dg.name as administered_drug_name, ma.dose as administered_dose, cnd.name as administered_dose_units, cnr.name as administered_route, map.uuid as medication_administration_performer_uuid, v.uuid as visit_uuid FROM medication_administration_performer map join provider pr on pr.provider_id = map.actor_id join medication_administration ma on map.medication_administration_id=ma.medication_administration_id join drug dg on dg.drug_id = ma.drug_id join ipd_slot slot on ma.medication_administration_id = slot.medication_administration_id join ipd_schedule schedule on schedule.schedule_id = slot.schedule_id join visit v on v.visit_id = schedule.visit_id JOIN (SELECT pri.patient_id, pri.identifier FROM patient_identifier pri join patient_identifier_type pit on pri.identifier_type = pit.patient_identifier_type_id and pri.preferred = 1 join global_property gp on gp.property="bahmni.primaryIdentifierType" and gp.property_value=pit.uuid) primaryIdentifier ON ma.patient_id = primaryIdentifier.patient_id join concept_name cn on cn.concept_id = map.performer_function and cn.concept_name_type = "FULLY_SPECIFIED" and cn.locale='en' join concept_name cnd on cnd.concept_id = ma.dose_units and cnd.concept_name_type = "FULLY_SPECIFIED" and cnd.locale='en' join concept_name cnr on cnr.concept_id = ma.route and cnr.concept_name_type = "FULLY_SPECIFIED" and cnr.locale='en' join person_name pn on ma.patient_id = pn.person_id and pn.voided = 0 and pn.preferred = 1 join patient_identifier pi on ma.patient_id = pi.patient_id join person p on p.person_id = ma.patient_id and p.voided = 0 WHERE cn.concept_name_type="FULLY_SPECIFIED" and cn.name="Witness" and pr.uuid = ${provider_uuid};
globalProperty.description: SQL query to get the list of emergency medications to be acknowledged

globalProperty.value: SELECT ord.uuid AS order_uuid, p.uuid AS patient_uuid, pi.identifier AS identifier, CONCAT_WS(' ', pn.given_name, pn.family_name) AS patient_name, COALESCE(test_short.name, test_full.name) AS test_name, (SELECT lab_no.value_text FROM obs lab_no JOIN concept_name lab_no_cn ON lab_no_cn.concept_id = lab_no.concept_id AND lab_no_cn.name = 'eRegister Lab Order Number' AND lab_no_cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND lab_no_cn.locale = 'en' AND lab_no_cn.voided = 0 WHERE lab_no.order_id = ord.order_id AND lab_no.voided = 0 ORDER BY lab_no.date_created DESC LIMIT 1) AS lab_order_number, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(o.date_created), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS received_at FROM obs o JOIN concept_name result_cn ON result_cn.concept_id = o.concept_id AND result_cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND result_cn.locale = 'en' AND result_cn.voided = 0 AND result_cn.name IN ( 'DISA, VL Result [#/vol]', 'DISA, VL Result [log#/vol]', 'DISA, VL Result (low value)', 'DISA, GeneXpert Result, MTB Result', 'DISA, GeneXpert Result, Rifampicin', 'DISA, VL Result Testdate', 'DISA, VL Result Comments', 'HIVTC, VL Pregnancy Status', 'HIVTC, VL Breastfeeding Status', 'DISA, Smear Result, Ziehl Neelsen', 'DISA, Smear Result, Grading', 'DISA, ZN Date', 'DISA, ZN Remarks') JOIN orders ord ON ord.order_id = o.order_id AND ord.voided = 0 JOIN order_type ot ON ot.order_type_id = ord.order_type_id AND ot.name = 'Lab Order' JOIN person p ON p.person_id = o.person_id AND p.voided = 0 LEFT JOIN person_name pn ON pn.person_id = p.person_id AND pn.preferred = 1 AND pn.voided = 0 LEFT JOIN patient_identifier pi ON pi.patient_id = p.person_id AND pi.preferred = 1 AND pi.voided = 0 LEFT JOIN concept_name test_short ON test_short.concept_id = ord.concept_id AND test_short.concept_name_type = 'SHORT' AND test_short.locale = 'en' AND test_short.voided = 0 LEFT JOIN concept_name test_full ON test_full.concept_id = ord.concept_id AND test_full.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND test_full.locale = 'en' AND test_full.voided = 0 WHERE o.voided = 0 AND o.date_created >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY ord.order_id, ord.uuid, p.uuid, pi.identifier, pn.given_name, pn.family_name, test_short.name, test_full.name ORDER BY MAX(o.date_created) DESC, ord.order_id DESC LIMIT 50
globalProperty.description: SQL query for the home page lab result notification bell: lab orders with result values received in the last 30 days
